## Prepare data for survival analysis

```{r}
survival_dat1 <- survival_dat %>% 
  drop_na(pat_id, status) %>% 
  left_join(clean_all_meta, by=c("pat_id"="patID"))

no.ukhd.pats <- length(grep(pattern = "UKL-HD", x = data$patID, ignore.case = TRUE))
fu.rate <- round(100/no.ukhd.pats * nrow(survival_dat1), 2)

(disease.no <- table(survival_dat1$disease))
```

Out of `r no.ukhd.pats` patients that were enrolled at the University Hospital Heidelberg we gathered Follow-Up data (ac-mortality) in `r nrow(survival_dat1)` (missing Follow-Up Rate = `r fu.rate`%). Among these patients `r disease.no["acs"]` patients suffered from ACS, `r disease.no["cad"]` patients had CAD, `r disease.no["dcm"]` patients had DCM, and `r disease.no["control"]` participants were assigned to the control group. 

We filter patients with HFpEF (n=5) and HFrEF (n=3).

```{r filter-patients}
survival_dat1 <- survival_dat1 %>% 
  filter(disease != "pef" & disease != "ref") %>% 
  mutate(time = time/365)

table(survival_dat1$disease)
```


# Descriptive KM stratified by disease

First, lets inspect survival times of the different diseases: 

```{r}
# easy KM
sfit_diseases <- survfit(Surv(time, status) ~ disease, data = survival_dat1)
ggsurvplot(fit = sfit_diseases, data = survival_dat1 )

# custom plot
p1.disease <- ggsurvplot_custom(fit_object = sfit_diseases, legend.title = "", myXbreaks = c(2.5, 5, 7.5),
                                 legend.labs = c("ACS", "CAD", "CONTROL", "DCM"), plot_inlay = FALSE,
                                save = FALSE, plotname = "p1_disease")
p1.disease



# 5y-mortality
survival_dat1 <- survival_dat1 %>%
  # 5y mortality
  mutate(status5y = ifelse(time>5, 0, status),
         time5y = ifelse(time>5, 5, time))

sfit_diseases.5y <- survfit(Surv(time5y, status5y) ~ disease, data = survival_dat1)
ggsurvplot(fit = sfit_diseases.5y, data = survival_dat1 )
```

# ML models survival probs

## Load ML models

```{r}
# load models and predict probability of disease
filenames2last.fit <- list.files("../output/test_set_results/test_results_20221127/")   # 9 models per disease
# rm "old" directory
index <- filenames2last.fit=="old"
filenames2last.fit <- filenames2last.fit[!index]

#space
name2assignModelInEnv <- list()
for (last.fit in 1:length(filenames2last.fit)) {
  selected.last.fit <- filenames2last.fit[last.fit]
  full.path <- paste0("../output/test_set_results/test_results_20221127/",selected.last.fit)
  name2assignInEnv <- gsub(pattern = "\\d+_TEST", replacement = "TEST", filenames2last.fit[last.fit])
  name2assignInEnv <- gsub(pattern = "\\.rds$", replacement = "", name2assignInEnv)  # backslash 2 escape the dot character (special character)
  name2assignModelInEnv[[last.fit]] <- name2assignInEnv
  assign(x = name2assignModelInEnv[[last.fit]], value = readRDS(full.path))
}

## NEED eval(as.symbol(X))
# eval(as.symbol(name2assignModelInEnv[[2]]))
```


We now predict all models we have per disease and add the probabilities to our survival data. 

```{r predict-whole-disease-dataset-and-filter-ukhd}
# only have surv data from 3 diseases
model.disease.vector <- c("acs", "cad", "dcm")
for (model.disease in 1:length(model.disease.vector)) {
  ## DATA 2 PREDICT FIRST
  # create parameter specific {disease}_ids
  filename <- paste0("/mnt/users/reich/BestAgeing/data/pheno_", model.disease.vector[model.disease], ".xlsx")
  disease_vector <- paste0(model.disease.vector[model.disease], "_ids")
  assign(x = disease_vector, 
         value = read_excel(filename) %>% 
           dplyr::pull(BestAgeingCode))
  
  
  disease_ident_df <- tibble(pat_id = c(eval(as.symbol(disease_vector)),control_ids), 
                             disease = c(rep(model.disease.vector[model.disease], length(eval(as.symbol(disease_vector)))),
                                         rep("control", length(control_ids)))
  )

  # prepare-combine-data
  data01 <- all_mirnas %>% 
    # filter control patients and from {disease}_ids
    filter(pat_id %in% !!sym(disease_vector) |
             pat_id %in% control_ids
    ) %>% 
    # bind age and gender from metadata
    left_join(clean_all_meta %>% select(patID, age, sex), 
              by = c("pat_id"= "patID") ) %>% 
    left_join(disease_ident_df, by = "pat_id") %>% 
    relocate(c(disease, age, sex), .after = pat_id) %>% 
    mutate(disease = factor(disease),
           sex = factor(sex) ) %>% 
    as_tibble()
  
  # select disease specific models
  index <- grep(pattern = model.disease.vector[model.disease], x = name2assignModelInEnv)
  
  for(mymodel in 1:length(index)) {
    modelInLoop <- name2assignModelInEnv[index][[mymodel]]
    colname.prefix <- gsub(pattern = "TEST_RESULTS_", replacement = "", modelInLoop)
    # 
    extract.workflow.loop <- extract_workflow(eval(as.symbol(modelInLoop)))
    predictions <- predict(test.extract.workflow, new_data=data01, type = "prob")
    # 
    colname_pred_control <- paste0(colnames(predictions)[1], "_", colname.prefix)
    colname_pred_disease <- paste0(colnames(predictions)[2], "_", colname.prefix)
    
    data01[1] %>% 
      cbind(predictions) -> temp.dat
    
    survival_dat1 %>% 
      left_join(temp.dat, by = join_by(pat_id)) %>% 
      rename(!! colname_pred_control := !! colnames(predictions)[1],
             !! colname_pred_disease := !! colnames(predictions)[2]) -> survival_dat1
    
    #mtcars %>% 
    #rename("PREFIX_{ OLD_COL_NAME }" := !! OLD_COL_NAME)
  }
}
```


## Use predictions and plot KM


```{r}

#cave : somewhere in deployment the .pred_control and corresponding disease column was called .pred_acs instead of .pred_{disease}

model.names <- c("RF" ,"XGB", "KNN", "SVM_radial","SVM_poly", "SVM_linear","neural_network", "full_quad_logistic_reg", "full_quad_KNN")
model.names.unique <- c("_RF_DISEASE" ,"_XGB_DISEASE", "KNN", "SVM_radial","SVM_poly", "SVM_linear","neural_network", "full_quad_logistic_reg", "full_quad_KNN")

# for LITERATURE miRNAs ONLY (other models not run yet)
for (mydisease in 1:length(model.disease.vector)) {
  colnames.control.predict <- paste0(".pred_control_", model.names, "_DISEASE_", model.disease.vector[mydisease], "_ANALYSIS_selected")
  colnames.disease.predict <- paste0(".pred_acs_", model.names, "_DISEASE_", model.disease.vector[mydisease], "_ANALYSIS_selected")  # cave here some bug .pred_acs instead of .pred_{disease}
  
  ## df only looking at patients with disease (no control) and with miRNA data!
  survival_dat1.disease <- survival_dat1 %>% 
    filter(disease == !! model.disease.vector[mydisease]) %>% 
    filter(!is.na(!! sym(colnames.control.predict[1])))
    
  
  # now loop over all models
  for (my9models in seq_along(model.names)) {
    colnames.control.predict.model <- colnames.control.predict[grep(model.names[my9models], x = colnames.control.predict,ignore.case = FALSE)]
    colnames.disease.predict.model <- colnames.disease.predict[grep(model.names[my9models], x = colnames.disease.predict,ignore.case = FALSE)]
    
    # KNN has 2 specs: "KNN" and "full_quad_KNN"
    if( length(colnames.control.predict.model) > 1 & model.names[my9models] == "KNN" ) {
      colnames.control.predict.model <- colnames.control.predict.model[1]
      colnames.disease.predict.model <- colnames.disease.predict.model[1]
    } else if ( length(colnames.control.predict.model) > 1 & model.names[my9models] == "full_quad_KNN" ) {
       colnames.control.predict.model <- colnames.control.predict.model[2]
       colnames.disease.predict.model <- colnames.disease.predict.model[2]
    }
    
    survival_dat1.disease <- survival_dat1.disease %>% 
      mutate(model.pred.groups = cut_number(!! sym(colnames.disease.predict.model), n=3)) %>% 
      mutate(model.pred.groups = factor(model.pred.groups, labels = c("low", "intermediate", "high")))
    
    
    # easy KM
    sfit_diseases <- survfit(Surv(time5y, status5y) ~ model.pred.groups, data = survival_dat1.disease)
    #test <- ggsurvplot(fit = sfit_diseases, data = survival_dat1.disease )
    surv.plotname <- str_remove(string = colnames.disease.predict.model, pattern = paste0(".pred_acs_"))  # AGAIN DISEASE BUG HERE, always acs
    surv.plotname <- paste0(toupper(model.disease.vector[mydisease]), "_", surv.plotname)
    surv.plottitle <- paste0(toupper(model.disease.vector[mydisease]), " probability predicted by ", model.names[my9models], " model")
    ggsurvplot_custom(fit_object = sfit_diseases, mytitle=surv.plottitle, legend.title = "Predicted disease probability: ", 
                      myXbreaks = c(1, 2,3,4, 5),
                      legend.labs = c("low", "intermediate", "high"), plot_inlay = FALSE,
                      save = TRUE, plotname = surv.plotname)
    
    
  }
}
```
